summary: P3 (deviation judged): `--ref` of the three leaves declares the domain NOT_BLANK (shared with evidence add --ref for atip.optionvalues.12), so the schema admits a multi-line value that check_call refuses (`--ref $'a\nb'` = CHANGE_ARGUMENT_INVALID '--ref must be one non-empty line').
